newsitem.title: PERU: Peru says jobless rate down to 7.1 pct Q4 1996.
newsitem.headline: Peru says jobless rate down to 7.1 pct Q4 1996.

text.p: The Peruvian jobless rate fell to 7.1 percent in the fourth quarter of last year, down from 7.5 percent in the same period of 1995, the Labor Ministry said Tuesday.

Among age groups, the highest unemployment rate, 13.5 percent, was among youths between 14 and 24 years old. The worst affected area, with 8.0 percent unemployment, was the southern highland zone of Peru.
The ministry began last year basing its unemployment figure on surveys throughout the country. The government's previous methodology had only collected data from the capital Lima.
Fourth quarter 1996 unemployment for men was 6.5 percent, down from 5.8 percent last year, while for women the rate fell to 8.0 percent from 9.8 percent.
Peru also has an underemployment rate of around 47 percent, according to government officials, with many in that figure working in the informal economy.
